components.css: .ds-mic{position:relative;width:132px;height:132px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:#2768ed;color:#fff;margin:28px 0 18px;box-shadow:0 0 0 8px var(--surface,#fff),0 0 0 9px #a8bce3;transition:transform .2s ease,background .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease;cursor:pointer}.ds-mic svg{display:block;width:57px;height:57px;margin:auto;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-mic:hover{transform:scale(1.04);background:#1853c8}.ds-mic:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-mic.active{background:#a63847;box-shadow:0 0 0 8px var(--surface,#fff),0 0 0 9px #c97983}.ds-mic:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#2768ed);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:390px){.ds-mic{width:120px;height:120px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-mic{transition-duration:.01ms!important}}

components.html:
Conversations

Pick up where you left off.

narrative.overview: A prominent blue microphone anchors a quiet, compact conversation surface; utilities, transcripts, and settings stay close at hand. Light and dark themes share the same shapes and hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: A single centered practice panel and a large circular microphone.
Cool neutrals with a blue action color and restrained rounded controls.
Dense, readable controls with visible focus and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Theme Roles Rule
rules.body: Use the matching page, surface, ink, muted, line, accent, and soft colors together for each theme.

rules.name: The Visible Focus Rule
rules.body: Buttons, inputs, and selects show a 3px theme-accent outline with a 3px offset on keyboard focus.

dos: Do pair light and dark theme roles for surfaces, text, dividers, and secondary accents.
Do keep the microphone and connection status prominent in the practice surface.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and support reduced motion.
donts: Don't remove the text status when presenting the animated activity waveform.
Don't prevent the drawer and form controls from stacking on narrow screens.
